messages:
Maya L: Heads-up — partner booth run-through for Slate Lane on Tues 6/10. Need a demo runner, on-call, press kits, and a swag handoff plan. Who can own on-call? Timeline: load test 9:30a, speaker mic check 10:00a, demo window 10:15-10:45.

Tony R: I can own on-call during the demo, on-site. What machine image are we using?

Sam K: Using ded-rt-1 (quantized) — bring fallback image ded-rt-1-fp16. Also: spare NVMe, 2x power bricks, and a USB-C→Ethernet dongle.

Elaine P: I’ll handle press kits + courier. What’s the sticker & swag count and any customs notes for EU?

Logistics Bot: Reminder: submit shipping request by EOD Fri. Created tracking placeholder #SLATE-345.

Tony R: Stickers: 200 general, 50 VIP. Swag: 40 demo postcards, 10 sample GPUs (loaners) labels. Elaine — can you confirm Thu pickup?

Elaine P: Confirmed FedEx Priority pickup Thu 3pm. Uploading commercial invoice + customs value to the drive folder now.

Maya L: Need someone to run the live script and cue the SI partner on-stage — Sam, can you take that?

Sam K: Yes. I’ll rehearse Mon 4pm PST with the partner. Can someone set a dial-in + camera angle notes? @Elaine can you add Zoom?

Elaine P: Zoom created: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 pass: slate123. Added camera notes: stage left close-up, two mics, wifi fallback.

Tony R: On-call checklist I’ll post in #eng-oncall: ssh keys verified, fallback image in /opt/models, local service restart alias, contact list = +1-555-2021 (Tony), +1-555-2022 (Maya), +1-555-2023 (Sam).

Maya L: Two last asks: 1) include a one-page runbook inside each press kit; 2) ensure a white-glove label on the demo machine case for fastest handoff. I’ll drop the runbook doc in drive.

Sam K: Quick run command I’ll use for local demo:

```
# local quick run
./run_demo --model ded-rt-1 --quantize q4
```

Tony R: Got it. I’ll pin contact numbers and the run command.

Elaine P: Packing list summary uploaded to drive: stickers, postcards, 2 power bricks, spare NVMe, 2 dongles, demo laptop, press kit (runbook + stickers).

Logistics Bot: Shipping label created and assigned to #SLATE-345. ETA to venue: Fri 18:00 local.

Maya L: Awesome — thanks all. Rehearsal Monday 4pm, on-site check Fri 9:30am. See you there! :rocket:
